definitions.gloss: correspondence; exchanging letters; pen pal relationship
definitions.explanation: The practice of regularly exchanging letters with someone, traditionally by physical mail. Often associated with pen pal friendships, especially among students.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{文通|ぶんつう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I correspond with a friend overseas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、{文通|ぶんつう}⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧がいて⟦{楽|たの}しかった→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I had a pen pal and it was fun.

examples.japanese: ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{普及|ふきゅう}する→普及する：22182_fukyuusuru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{文通|ぶんつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{異文化|いぶんか}→異文化：15703_ibunka⟧⟦{交流|こうりゅう}→交流：02732_kouryuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧な⟦{手段|しゅだん}→手段：03219_shudan⟧だった。
examples.english: Before email became widespread, exchanging letters was an important means of cross-cultural exchange.

notes:
The practice of exchanging letters with someone on a regular basis. Combines ⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧ (writing, letter) and ⟦{通|つう}→〜通：04025_tsuu⟧ (pass through, communicate).

USAGE:
- Traditionally refers to exchanging physical letters, especially as pen pals
- Was very popular among Japanese students in the Showa and Heisei eras as a way to make friends
- Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form the verb: {文通|ぶんつう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to correspond, to exchange letters)
- While email and messaging have largely replaced physical letter writing, the word is still understood and occasionally used

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文通|ぶんつう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to correspond by letter
- {文通|ぶんつう}⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧: pen pal, correspondent
- {文通|ぶんつう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める: to start corresponding
- {文通|ぶんつう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to continue corresponding

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ペンパル: pen pal — the loanword, referring specifically to the person
- ⟦{通信|つうしん}→通信：03514_tsuushin⟧: communication, correspondence — broader; includes all forms of communication
- ⟦{書簡|しょかん}→書簡：20091_shokan⟧: written correspondence, letters — more formal and literary
